subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit period clarification
messages:
From: Beth Kincaid <beth.kincaid@acme-corp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit period clarification

Hi Alex,

We're starting procurement for a new integration and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our security review. A couple of asks to get us moving:

- Please confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II report covering the 2026 calendar year (Jan 1, 2026 – Dec 31, 2026). If not, what audit period is covered by the latest Type II?
- If the latest Type II doesn't cover our desired period, would you provide a bridge letter that confirms continuity of controls between reports?
- Can you share a minimal evidence list (policy docs, network diagram, log retention examples) and preferred secure transfer mechanisms (SFTP, Drive, or vendor portal)?

We'd like to close the security questionnaire by May 24. If you can share the report/bridge letter and the evidence list this week that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Beth Kincaid
Sr. Security Program Manager, Acme Corporation
beth.kincaid@acme-corp.com

--
Acme Security Team
security@acme-corp.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit period clarification

Hi Beth — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary up front: we do have a SOC 2 Type II report and can provide a bridge letter if the period doesn't align with your requirement. Below is a concise "what to expect" + a minimal evidence matrix and secure-share options.

1) Report / audit period
- Latest packaged: SOC 2 Type II report covering the audit period 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 (common overlap window for our auditor this year).
- If your required period is calendar 2026, we provide a bridge letter that attests to continuous controls as of 2027-01-15 and documents changes since the prior report.

2) Minimal evidence we can share (attached spreadsheet has checkboxes):
- Final Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (PDF, we can redline if needed)
- System/network diagram (redacted)
- Log retention policy + sample log export (redacted)
- Change management policy + example PR/ticket (IDs redacted)
- Access control summary (roles + sample user access review)
- Backup & DR summary (location and retention; detailed backups only on NDA)
- Complementary User-Entity Controls guidance (CUC)

3) Secure transfer options
- Preferred: short-lived Google Drive folder with viewer-only links + requestor ACL (we'll send invite to security@acme-corp.com).
- Alternate: SFTP with temporary account / presigned S3 links (we'll provide hostname and creds).
- For audited artifacts that contain PII we require a minimal NDA; we can gate via our vendor portal.

4) Suggested response templates (useful for your questionnaire):
- Report available: "Redwood Inference can provide a SOC 2 Type II report for 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. A bridge letter attesting continuity is available on request."
- Evidence location: "Artifacts can be shared via a short-lived Google Drive folder or secure SFTP; access will be granted to security@acme-corp.com."

I've attached a draft bridge letter and the minimal evidence list spreadsheet for your reviewers. Naomi (cc'd) is our security lead — Naomi, can you confirm the NDA threshold for full backups and give the greenlight on Drive vs SFTP?

Next steps: if you confirm the preferred transfer method and whether the audit window is acceptable, we'll send the Drive invite and the two documents this afternoon.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102

Hi Beth — answers inline: 

- Scope: The packaged SOC 2 Type II and the attached minimal evidence package are scoped to our production environment and customer-facing services only. Non-production/staging systems are explicitly out of scope and called out in section 2.3 of the report. You can use the sentence: "Report and artifacts apply to Redwood's production inference runtime and associated control plane; dev/staging systems are out of scope."

- Backups: We can share backup metadata (retention windows, snapshot cadence, and anonymized timestamps) without an NDA. Full backup archives or raw data will require a signed NDA. We'll include a sample CSV that shows retention intervals and example timestamps with all identifiers redacted.

- Timeline: Yes — we can deliver the Type II PDF, the bridge letter, and the minimal evidence checklist into a short-lived Drive folder for security@acme-corp.com by EOD May 14. Naomi: please confirm you'll create the Drive share and invite security@acme-corp.com this afternoon.

If you need a short canned reply for procurement, feel free to reuse: 

"Redwood Inference will provide a SOC 2 Type II report (2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31) and an accompanying bridge letter attesting continuity for calendar 2026. Artifacts will be shared via a short-lived Google Drive link to security@acme-corp.com on 2027-05-14."

Thanks — we'll follow up once the folder is live.

Regards,
Alex
